propositions: Step 0 — Orient section does not exist before Phase 1 in SKILL.md, preventing agents from searching for existing duplicate tickets or establishing a reported-against version floor before filing

A bug report's version floor must be derived either from explicit rebar/git version in report text or converted from ticket created_at (nanoseconds to unix seconds via /1000000000 divisor), then used to limit scope via git log range; raw nanosecond values passed to git --before= silently return the tip
The Step-0 duplicates link and resume decision must be pre-approved in the approval-gate carve-out to avoid blocking agent action on its own tracker writes
759 of 764 bug tickets are closed; an open-only tracker sweep misses 99.3% of closed tickets and cannot detect regressions or duplicate reports

The skill must document explicit nanosecond-to-seconds conversion, unknown-version fallback, and worktree currency check, with test validation ensuring the command form is correct and the broken form is absent
